frame.method: Exact original body/head pixels in their existing common frame. Added pair shares contact and physical scale; no independent bounding-box fitting.

body_pixels: Original RGBA exact, including hidden RGB at alpha0; no resampling.
editable_geometry: Rounded additional-foot contours and toe curves retained; gradient values alone derive from generated proposals. Original pelvis/arms/legs/head remain exact.

source_colour.detail_assignment: No body pixels assigned to native B detail during this phase. Exact semantic region is not exported. Rime-vein/icy-particle appearance is mutation/cosmetic work outside the initial body phase; B is retained for later native/effect mapping, not invented as permanent blue skin.
source_colour.base_neutral: All production RGB is grayscale; no fixed biological skin colour or blue pixels.
